title: Editor E0 task 12b, the email campaign loads as nodes and the canvas pane mounts the node editor behind render_path_email
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-20. loadEmailCampaign returns nodeLayout (a stored node document as it is, a legacy one upgraded in memory; nothing is written until the first edit) only while render_path_email is on; EmailEditorPane's canvas arrangement then mounts NodeLayoutProvider, seeds it and renders NodeEmailCanvasEditor, saving the node document through the same saveCampaign (the server decides via prepareEmailLayoutWrite). Switch off: no change. The stacked and trio arrangements stay legacy. Next: Space email draft load, nurture saves, step-block-editor, then the member side.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];if(!fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/admin/email-studio/actions.ts','utf8').includes(\"renderPathEnabled('email')\"))bad.push('campaign load not behind render_path_email');const p=fs.readFileSync('components/admin/email-studio/editor-pane.tsx','utf8');if(!p.includes('NodeEmailCanvasEditor')||!p.includes('NodeLayoutProvider'))bad.push('pane does not mount the node editor');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1059: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the campaign load serves nodes without the switch, or the canvas pane stops mounting the node editor.
